SWAPPER

Live direct ERC-20 swaps, followed by deeply unqualified wisdom. LANDVILLE builds the reviewed plan. Your linked wallet confirms and signs it.

THE 99 / 1 RULE

ONE INPUT. TWO DESTINATIONS.

1% goes to the immutable LANDVILLE treasury. The remaining 99% enters the requested Uniswap V3 pool.

WHO SIGNS?

YOU. NOT SCRAPY.

LANDVILLE validates the adapter request and presents a trusted confirmation. Your wallet displays and signs the final transaction.

RWA NOTICE

A CONTRACT IS NOT LIQUIDITY.

Tokenized assets work only when valid ERC-20 contracts have a supported direct pool with usable liquidity.

TRANSACTION BOUNDARY: This kiosk sends only literal requests to the installed quote, exact-approval and exact-input swap adapters. It receives no provider, signature, key, recipient control or arbitrary calldata permission. A swap is labeled submitted only after LANDVILLE returns a transaction hash.

imageGeneration.purpose: Generate one citizen-specific illustrated portrait used as the identifying visual on the post-swap X-ready receipt card.
imageGeneration.visualDirection: A single waist-up citizen portrait described by the user, rendered as a hand-cut LANDVILLE junkyard passport photograph: warm paper, dirty ink, salvaged-metal details, acid-lime accents, hard flash lighting and a transparent-looking uncluttered dark background. It must not imitate a named artist, fabricate a verified likeness or include logos, token prices, wallet addresses or financial claims.

transactions.purpose: Quote and execute a citizen-confirmed direct Robinhood Mainnet ERC-20 swap through the installed LANDVILLE fee router, including exact gross approval and the immutable 1% input-token treasury fee.
